snippet.title: The Temple of Elemental Evil - Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description: Don't miss the Launch Trailer for The Temple of Elemental Evil, a turn-based fantasy Dungeons & Dragons RPG developed by Trokia Games. Players will overcome challenges to explore the titular temple. Assemble a party worthy of dispatching monsters and cultists and seek the truth behind the evil that roams the land. The Temple of Elemental Evil is available now for PC (Steam).
